in_hebrew.name: כָסְפָר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'kaphar' meaning 'to hide, to cover'. The name Kaspar is derived from the word 'kaspa' meaning 'box, chest, treasury'. This name is biblical and refers to a wise man from the East who came to worship the infant Jesus (Matthew 2:1-12).

in_greek.name: Κασπαρ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'kasparos' meaning 'treasurer, box, chest'. This name is derived from the Hebrew name 'Kaspar'. The name is biblical and is mentioned in the New Testament as the name of one of the magi who came to worship Jesus (Matthew 2:1-12).

in_latin.name: Caspar
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'caspar' meaning 'treasurer, box, chest'. This name is derived from the Greek name 'Kasparos' and the Hebrew name 'Kaspar'. The name is biblical and is mentioned in the New Testament as the name of one of the magi who came to worship Jesus (Matthew 2:1-12).
